articles.headline: Congress passes war powers measure for first time, rebuking Trump's war with Iran
articles.summary: The resolution is largely symbolic, but it adds to pressure on the White House to end the conflict once and for all.
articles._summary: The Republican-controlled US Senate has approved a measure instructing President Donald Trump to halt the war in Iran or seek congressional approval before continuing military action. A handful of Republicans joined Democrats in Tuesday's 50-48 vote. The same measure was passed by the US House of Representatives earlier this month. But the resolution is largely symbolic because, even after passing both chambers of Congress, it will not be sent to Trump for his consideration and does not carry the force of the law. It came as Republicans in Congress have expressed scepticism about a peace plan Trump agreed with Iran, and the unpopular conflict approaches its fifth month. UN says it will evacuate sailors stranded in Strait of Hormuz, as Rubio warns against tolls Trump criticised the resolution on Tuesday night, calling it "poorly timed and meaningless".
articles._zh_headline: 国会首次通过战争权力措施，谴责特朗普与伊朗的战争
articles._zh_summary: 共和党控制的美国参议院批准了一项措施，指示唐纳德·特朗普总统停止伊朗战争或在继续采取军事行动之前寻求国会批准。在周二的投票中，少数共和党人以 50 比 48 的投票结果加入了民主党的行列。本月早些时候，美国众议院也通过了同样的措施。但该决议在很大程度上是象征性的，因为即使在国会参众两院获得通过，它也不会送交特朗普审议，也不具有法律效力。国会共和党人对特朗普与伊朗达成的和平计划表示怀疑，这场不受欢迎的冲突已进入第五个月。联合国表示将撤离滞留在霍尔木兹海峡的水手，鲁比奥警告不要造成人员伤亡。特朗普周二晚批评该决议，称其“时机不当且毫无意义”。

articles.headline: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
articles.summary: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.
articles._summary: US congressman Dan Goldman has been defeated in a New York primary election, capping a clean sweep for candidates backed by New York's democratic socialist Mayor Zohran Mamdani. Goldman was beaten by progressive challenger Brad Lander in New York's 10th congressional district in a contest that laid bare the party's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war. Lander has accused Israel of genocide in Gaza. Goldman, a two-term incumbent, was backed by pro-Israel groups. Two other candidates, both democratic socialists endorsed by Mamdani as he seeks to tilt the Democratic party to the left, won their primary races on Tuesday, in a boost for the party's left wing in America's largest city. Assemblywoman Claire Valdez unseated Brooklyn Borough President Antonio Reynoso in the 7th district. Darializa Avila Chevalier, a doctoral student who has joined pro-Palestinian protests at Columbia University, won her race in New York's 13th district.
articles._zh_headline: 马姆达尼支持的候选人在纽约民主党初选中大获全胜
articles._zh_summary: 美国国会议员丹·戈德曼(Dan Goldman)在纽约初选中落败，纽约民主社会主义市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼(Zohran Mamdani)支持的候选人大获全胜。高盛在纽约第十国会选区的竞选中被进步挑战者布拉德·兰德击败，这场竞选暴露了该党在以色列-加沙战争问题上的分歧。兰德指责以色列在加沙实施种族灭绝。高盛曾连任两届，得到了亲以色列团体的支持。另外两名候选人在周二的初选中赢得了初选，这为该党在美国最大城市的左翼势力带来了提振。女议员克莱尔·瓦尔迪兹 (Claire Valdez) 在第七选区罢免了布鲁克林区主席安东尼奥·雷诺索 (Antonio Reynoso)。参加哥伦比亚大学亲巴勒斯坦抗议活动的博士生 Darializa Avila Chevalier 在纽约第 13 区的竞选中获胜。

articles.headline: In symbolic vote, Congress directs Trump to remove forces from Iran war
articles.summary: The measure to remove U.S. armed forces from hostilities with Iran does not require the president's signature, nor does it carry the force of law. But it reflects bipartisan frustration with the war.
articles._summary: The U.S. Capitol and National Mall is seen on June 13, 2026. Rahmat Gul/AP hide caption A bipartisan majority in Congress has voted in favor of a war powers resolution to remove U.S. armed forces from hostilities with Iran. The Senate voted 50 to 48 on Tuesday afternoon, with four Republicans joining Democrats in support. They were Bill Cassidy of Louisiana, Susan Collins of Maine, Rand Paul of Kentucky and Alaska's Lisa Murkowski. The measure, which is not legally binding and will not be sent to the White House for a signature, was approved by the House earlier this month . "Today, Congress stood up to Donald Trump and voted to end his costly, unnecessary, and devastating war with Iran," Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., said in a statement after the vote. "The message from the only branch of government with the power to declare war is unmistakable: the Trump administration must withdraw U.S. forces from hostilities in Iran."
articles._zh_headline: 国会象征性投票指示特朗普从伊朗战争中撤军
articles._zh_summary: 2026 年 6 月 13 日，美国国会大厦和国家广场。 Rahmat Gul/美联社 隐藏标题 国会两党多数投票赞成一项战争权力决议，以让美国武装部队摆脱与伊朗的敌对行动。周二下午，参议院以 50 比 48 的投票结果，四名共和党人和民主党人一起表示支持。他们是路易斯安那州的比尔·卡西迪、缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯、肯塔基州的兰德·保罗和阿拉斯加州的丽莎·默科斯基。该措施不具有法律约束力，也不会送交白宫签署，已于本月初获得众议院批准。纽约州参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默在投票后发表的一份声明中表示：“今天，国会勇敢地面对唐纳德·特朗普，并投票决定结束他与伊朗之间代价高昂、不必要且毁灭性的战争。” “唯一有权宣战的政府部门发出的信息是明确无误的：特朗普政府必须从伊朗的敌对行动中撤出美军。”

articles.headline: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin Drop Further Amid Global Chip Sell-Off: Analyst Flags 'The Most Important Level' For BTC
articles.summary: Leading cryptocurrencies cracked alongside stocks on Tuesday, June 23, after a sharp decline in chip-related stocks cast doubts on the sustainability of the AI rally.
articles._summary: Leading cryptocurrencies cracked alongside stocks on Tuesday, after a sharp decline in chip-related stocks cast doubts on the sustainability of the AI rally. Bitcoin dropped below $62,000 amid heavy selling, while Ethereum bulls failed to defend the support at $1,700. XRP and Dogecoin recorded sharp declines as well. Over $560 million was liquidated from the cryptocurrency market in the last 24 hours, with $490 million in bullish long positions wiped out, according to Coinglass data.

articles.headline: Nasdaq Tumbles Over 2% Amid Plunge In Semiconductor Shares: Investor Sentiment Declines, Greed Index Remains In ‘Fear’ Zone
articles.summary: Market sentiment declined as Nasdaq fell over 2%. Tech stocks, including Micron and SanDisk, tumbled. Dow closed lower, while S&P 500 and Nasdaq also dropped.
articles._summary: The CNN Money Fear and Greed index showed a decline in overall market sentiment, while it remained in the “Fear” zone on Tuesday. U.S. stocks settled lower on Tuesday, with the Nasdaq Composite falling more than 2% amid a global sell-off in semiconductor shares. On the economic data front, the S&P Global US services PMI climbed to 51.3 in June from 50.7 in the previous month, higher than market estimates of 51.
